## About
Air Dynamics Mechanical is a family heating and cooling business in San Antonio. We repair, install and maintain air conditioners and heating systems for homes and businesses, and we work on all makes and models of equipment.
We try to get the job done right the first time. Before we begin a repair, you'll get a written estimate that covers our charges. We keep many factory parts on our trucks to speed things up, and we clean up our materials before we leave.
We work all over the Greater San Antonio area, from Stone Oak and Live Oak to Helotes, Windcrest and Boerne. Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 231 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to help your family too.

## Services
- AC Repair: When your air conditioner stops cooling, we'll find the problem and fix it, on all makes and models.
- AC Installation: Residential and commercial air conditioning installation. No job is too big or small.
- Indoor Air Quality: Help so you and your family breathe the cleanest air possible at home.
- HVAC Service: Repair and installation for your heating and cooling systems, all makes and models.
- Heating System Service: We'll inspect your equipment and let you know of any problems, or potential problems, before the cold sets in.
- Heating System Repair: When wear and tear slows your heater down or it stops working, we'll get it running again.
- Heating System Installation: For a single family home or a larger building, we'll design a heating setup that fits.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Our site lists 24/7 emergency HVAC service, so give us a call.

Q: Is the estimate free for a new system?
A: Yes. If you need a new air conditioner or heater installed, we can give you a free estimate.

Q: Do you charge for travel time?
A: No. We don't charge for travel time.

Q: Is your work under warranty?
A: Yes. Our results come backed by a two-year warranty.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing for your HVAC project is available through GreenSky.
